**@fungi.computer/issues**

# API reference

`inspectIssueTree(files)` accepts a record of relative file paths to Markdown
text. Its report includes records, diagnostics, summaries and the unblocked
frontier. Invalid tickets leave records empty. Filesystem discovery, Git
identity and persistence belong to the caller.

## Public entrypoints

- `@fungi.computer/issues`

Type declarations ship beside each JavaScript entrypoint. The README owns usage,
lifetime rules and limitations.
